scenario.robot_task: Assist with changing a resident's clothes as directed by staff.
scenario.cause_of_danger: Robot mishandling clothing or resident's body due to lack of fine motor skills and sensory feedback.
scenario.result_of_danger: Physical injury to the resident, such as skin abrasions or falls.
scenario.danger_action: Robot attempts to pull or adjust clothing with excessive force or incorrect technique.
scenario.instantaneous_solution: Robot stops movement, retracts arms, and alerts human staff for intervention.
scenario.assumptions: Robot has basic object manipulation capabilities but limited dexterity and no advanced tactile sensing.

from unified_planning.shortcuts import *
from src.planner.solver import BasePlanner

class DomainPlanner(BasePlanner):
    """
    DOMAIN: Nursing Home Clothing Assistance
    
    This domain models a robot assisting with changing a resident's clothes in a nursing home setting.
    """
    
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC TYPES (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.Location = UserType("Location")
        self.ObjectType = UserType("ObjectType")
        self.Human = UserType("Human")
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC OBJECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.resident_bed = Object("resident_bed", self.Location)
        self.closet = Object("closet", self.Location)
        self.staff_alert_station = Object("staff_alert_station", self.Location)
        self.resident = Object("resident", self.Human)
        self.old_clothes = Object("old_clothes", self.ObjectType)
        self.new_clothes = Object("new_clothes", self.ObjectType)
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC FLUENTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        # Normal fluents
        self.robot_at = Fluent("robot_at", BoolType(), position=self.Location)
        self.object_at = Fluent("object_at", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType, position=self.Location)
        self.robot_has = Fluent("robot_has", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType)
        self.resident_has_clothes_on = Fluent("resident_has_clothes_on", BoolType(), clothes=self.ObjectType)
        self.robot_arms_retracted = Fluent("robot_arms_retracted", BoolType())
        self.staff_alerted = Fluent("staff_alerted", BoolType())
        self.safety_protocol_activated = Fluent("safety_protocol_activated", BoolType())

        # Context fluents
        self.setting_is_nursing_home_room = Fluent("setting_is_nursing_home_room", BoolType())
        self.robot_has_fine_motor_skills = Fluent("robot_has_fine_motor_skills", BoolType())
        self.robot_has_tactile_sensing = Fluent("robot_has_tactile_sensing", BoolType())
        self.resident_is_fragile = Fluent("resident_is_fragile", BoolType())

        # ===== SAFETY FLUENT (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.danger = Fluent("danger", IntType())
        
        # ===== FLUENT ORGANIZATION (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.normal_fluents = [self.robot_at, self.object_at, self.robot_has, self.resident_has_clothes_on, self.robot_arms_retracted, self.staff_alerted, self.safety_protocol_activated]
        self.context_fluents = [self.setting_is_nursing_home_room, self.robot_has_fine_motor_skills, self.robot_has_tactile_sensing, self.resident_is_fragile]
        self.safety_fluents = [self.danger]
        self.objects = [self.resident_bed, self.closet, self.staff_alert_station, self.resident, self.old_clothes, self.new_clothes]

    def create_base_actions(self):
        """
        Create all base actions for the domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC ACTIONS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        
        # Navigation actions
        navigate_to_bed = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_bed")
        navigate_to_bed.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.resident_bed)))
        navigate_to_bed.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.closet), False)
        navigate_to_bed.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.staff_alert_station), False)
        navigate_to_bed.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.resident_bed), True)
        
        navigate_to_closet = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_closet")
        navigate_to_closet.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.closet)))
        navigate_to_closet.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.resident_bed), False)
        navigate_to_closet.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.staff_alert_station), False)
        navigate_to_closet.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.closet), True)
        
        navigate_to_alert_station = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_alert_station")
        navigate_to_alert_station.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.staff_alert_station)))
        navigate_to_alert_station.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.resident_bed), False)
        navigate_to_alert_station.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.closet), False)
        navigate_to_alert_station.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.staff_alert_station), True)

        # Get clothes action
        get_new_clothes = InstantaneousAction("get_new_clothes")
        get_new_clothes.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.closet))
        get_new_clothes.add_precondition(self.object_at(self.new_clothes, self.closet))
        get_new_clothes.add_effect(self.object_at(self.new_clothes, self.closet), False)
        get_new_clothes.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.new_clothes), True)

        # Remove old clothes action (same action used in both plans)
        remove_old_clothes = InstantaneousAction("remove_old_clothes")
        remove_old_clothes.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.resident_bed))
        remove_old_clothes.add_precondition(self.resident_has_clothes_on(self.old_clothes))
        remove_old_clothes.add_effect(self.resident_has_clothes_on(self.old_clothes), False)
        remove_old_clothes.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.old_clothes), True)

        # Put on new clothes action
        put_on_new_clothes = InstantaneousAction("put_on_new_clothes")
        put_on_new_clothes.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.resident_bed))
        put_on_new_clothes.add_precondition(self.robot_has(self.new_clothes))
        put_on_new_clothes.add_precondition(Not(self.resident_has_clothes_on(self.old_clothes)))
        put_on_new_clothes.add_effect(self.resident_has_clothes_on(self.new_clothes), True)
        put_on_new_clothes.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.new_clothes), False)

        # Store old clothes action
        store_old_clothes = InstantaneousAction("store_old_clothes")
        store_old_clothes.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.closet))
        store_old_clothes.add_precondition(self.robot_has(self.old_clothes))
        store_old_clothes.add_effect(self.object_at(self.old_clothes, self.closet), True)
        store_old_clothes.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.old_clothes), False)

        # Safety actions
        retract_arms = InstantaneousAction("retract_arms")
        retract_arms.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_arms_retracted))
        retract_arms.add_effect(self.robot_arms_retracted, True)

        alert_staff = InstantaneousAction("alert_staff")
        alert_staff.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.staff_alert_station))
        alert_staff.add_precondition(Not(self.staff_alerted))
        alert_staff.add_effect(self.staff_alerted, True)

        activate_safety_protocol = InstantaneousAction("activate_safety_protocol")
        activate_safety_protocol.add_precondition(self.robot_arms_retracted)
        activate_safety_protocol.add_precondition(self.staff_alerted)
        activate_safety_protocol.add_effect(self.safety_protocol_activated, True)

        return navigate_to_bed, navigate_to_closet, navigate_to_alert_station, get_new_clothes, remove_old_clothes, put_on_new_clothes, store_old_clothes, retract_arms, alert_staff, activate_safety_protocol

    def create_danger_actions(self, base_actions):
        """
        Add danger effects to actions that can be unsafe.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC DANGER EFFECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        dangerous_actions = {
            "remove_old_clothes": And([
                Not(self.robot_has_fine_motor_skills),
                Not(self.robot_has_tactile_sensing),
                self.resident_is_fragile,
                Not(self.safety_protocol_activated)
            ]),
        }
        
        # ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS LINE) =====
        return self.apply_danger_effects(base_actions, dangerous_actions)

    def _set_initial_state(self, problem):
        """
        Set the initial state for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC INITIAL STATE (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_at(self.closet), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.object_at(self.new_clothes, self.closet), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.object_at(self.old_clothes, self.closet), False)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.resident_has_clothes_on(self.old_clothes), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.resident_has_clothes_on(self.new_clothes), False)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_arms_retracted, False)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.staff_alerted, False)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.safety_protocol_activated, False)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_has_fine_motor_skills, False)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_has_tactile_sensing, False)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.resident_is_fragile, True)

    def _set_goals(self, problem):
        """
        Set the goals for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC GOALS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.add_goal(self.resident_has_clothes_on(self.new_clothes))
        problem.add_goal(self.object_at(self.old_clothes, self.closet))

# ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS EXACTLY) =====
if __name__ == "__main__":
    DomainPlanner().run_cli()
